attr.title: Omni Bonk
attr.desc: A 3D low-poly roguelite survivor in honor of Megabonk. Your attacks are automatic: run, jump and slide through 3 maps, 43 enemies, 30 weapons, 23 tomes and 86 items. Non-commercial fan project with original procedural art, music and sound. Adjustable time per stage (15 min by default), 6 languages and an Auto quality mode that holds 40-60 FPS on the R36S (1 GB).
attr.inst: Ready to Run, no game files needed. Extract the zip into the ports folder (
and the omnibonk folder) and restart EmulationStation.
